snippet.title: Sachcha Musalmaan Kaun? Zabaan Aur Haath | Sahih Bukhari 10 #shorts
snippet.description:
Sachcha Musalmaan kaun? Namaz, roza... aur ek badi nishani!

Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (Radi Allahu Anhuma) se riwayat hai ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ»
"Musalmaan woh hai, jis ki zabaan aur haath se doosre Musalmaan mehfooz rahein."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 10: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:10

Zabaan se: na gaali, na taana, na gheebat. Haath se: na dhakka, na zulm, na kisi ka haq maarna. Phone par likhte waqt bhi yaad rakhein: kisi ka dil na dukhe. Comment mein likhein: Ya Allah, hamein sachcha Musalmaan bana de! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
